第13章斩草除根
“好大的口气，好狂妄的人！”
红脸大汉震怒道：“我倒要看看，在武林正道群雄齐至之际，到底是谁有这么大胆子。他既然现在没能毒死这些老鼠，那就永远也毒不死它们，我四海堂要养着它们，看看谁敢让我们四海堂鸡犬不留！”
红脸大汉这话掷地有声，唐大先生却道：“老黄，你这话说的太满了！”
“这毒我解不了……你去找其他人吧！”说罢便转身离去。
红脸大汉吩咐手下道：“去请诸位用毒大家和神医，再去问齐秋子神医来了没有。还有，把这些老鼠都抓起来……”说罢，他就走向钱晨，面露和蔼的笑容道：“这位小兄弟就是刚刚点出鼠群中毒之人吧！”
“不知小兄弟如何称呼？”
红脸大汉亲热的拍了拍钱晨的肩膀，钱晨一脸羞涩道：“我叫钱晨，是个无名小卒。”
“哈哈……钱老弟现在是个无名小卒，以后定然能名扬四海。从今日起，钱老弟就不是什么无名小卒了。不知这毒，钱老弟是如何看出来的？”
钱晨好像没有看出来红脸大汉隐藏的怀疑，兴高采烈道：“我有家传医术，一看就察觉了不对，这是昔年碧磷五毒教的‘斩草除根’，他把毒下在了虱子上，老鼠被虱子咬的越痒，就越会相互磨蹭，这样很快毒就传染了所有的老鼠。”
“这些老鼠被毒药驱使逃离四海堂，‘斩草除根’发作，他们鼠毛蜕去，这时候虱子也就和鼠毛一起落下，下毒的线索也就消失了，同时大家都只注意脱毛的老鼠，就会忽视鼠毛……这才是他真正的杀手。”
“他真正的目的，是让在场的人身中斩草除根的剧毒。等到他有所需要，就能让任意一人发狂杀人！”
听了钱晨这话，四海堂门口所有的人都跟疯了一样，他们拼命脱下衣服，扒拉着身上寻找虱子，抓着头发往外揪。
一时间，四海堂门口成了黄的，白的，黑的各种颜色的皮肤和肉色的海洋，临海城的百姓目瞪口呆看着本地赫赫有名四海堂门口，所有人像是着火了一样，把自己扒成了一只光猪。
红脸大汉也脸色难看，他强忍着身上痒痒的幻痛，对钱晨越发看重起来。
钱晨却诧异道：“他们为什么要脱衣服啊？”
“因为害怕中毒！”红脸大汉肚子里骂道：“老子也怕中毒啊！该死的，谁叫老子要面子。不能动……”
钱晨似乎回过神来，恍然道：“哦！我在发现毒是‘斩草除根’的时候就想明白了一切，然后在鼠毛里下了除虫药，已经隔绝了‘斩草除根’的传染过程。”听到这话，所有人才松了一口气，有人叫骂道：“嘛了个巴子，你小子怎么不早点说。”
红脸大汉高声道：“够了！岂能如此对救命恩人说话。”他对钱晨一抱拳道：“多谢小兄弟，救了我们所有人。”
“不知小兄弟是什么时候下除虫药的，我都没有看出来。”

“我身上哪里会带除虫药啊！”钱晨笑道：“只是借用了下毒那人的毒药而已，他就是下了除虫之毒，才毒死了这么多苍蝇臭虫。而这种除虫药唯一毒不死虱子，但我加了一味，便是一种药香。有了这一味药，虱子就不能免疫那种除虫之毒，自然也被毒死了。”
钱晨从腰间解下香囊，递给红脸大汉道：“我就是用这种药香，激发除虫药的毒性，所以我所到之处，虱子纷纷死绝。”
“刚刚我走进鼠群，就已经完成了解毒的过程。”
红脸大汉闻了闻那香囊，果然有一股馥郁的药香，他多了一个心眼，随手收下香囊，对钱晨道：“小兄弟可真是我们四海堂的贵客，快快请进……”
红脸大汉亲自将钱晨迎入堂中，种种礼数极其周全，钱晨摆出一副手足无措，盛情难却的样子，一脸青涩，看上去极不好意思。红脸大汉哈哈笑道：“今日，小兄弟就是我们四海堂的上宾，谁若敢怠慢了你，你跟哥哥说，我扒了他的皮……不知小兄弟还有没有办法解去这‘斩草除根’之毒，保住我们四海堂的面子。”
“若是能保住哥哥我的脸面，定有后报！”
“我在家传医书中看过几个方子，若是药材齐全，可以试一试。”钱晨红着脸呐呐道。
经过介绍，钱晨才知道这红脸大汉名为黄玉函，乃是四海堂，东西南北四个堂之中，东海堂的堂主。也是洪四海的大管家，负责四海堂总堂的一应内政。
在江湖中可谓位高权重，只是本人极少出手，因此武功高低也无从估计。
从四海堂大门入内，钱晨才知道什么叫气象森严，无数明哨暗哨，将四海堂保卫的水泼不进，更是因为刚刚发生的变故，所有人都提起了精神，身上愈发杀气凛然。黄玉函带着钱晨穿过了内殿，沿着回廊，来到一处偏殿之中。
“这座偏殿是堂内储备药物所用，虽然并非正式内藏库，却也药材种类齐全。”
“小兄弟可以看一看，还缺什么药材吗？”
钱晨推门进去，就被四海堂的豪阔吓了一跳，这偏殿里摆满了桐木架子，架子上大量的珍贵药材，像是不值钱一样堆放着，钱晨甚至闻到了一股因为保存不善的淡淡霉味。他仿佛医痴一般，急切上前翻弄那些盛放珍贵药物的盒子。
“这是海外出产的麒麟血竭！”
“这里还有龙脑，麟趾……这玉茯苓怎么放坏了！”
“小兄弟想要配什么药材，尽可以选择。”黄玉函笑道，钱晨毫不客气捻起各种珍贵药材，又要来了一只脱毛鼠，很快就配置好一副汤剂，一副药灌下去，那老鼠两腿一蹬，果然死了。黄玉函哈哈大笑，毫不介意，又奉上更多的珍贵药材。
钱晨治死了三次之后，终于配出一副汤剂，给老鼠灌下去后，虽然气息奄奄，却坚强的活了下来。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 13: Cutting out the roots
"What a loud tone, what an arrogant person!"
The red-faced man said angrily: "I want to see who is so bold when all the heroes of the righteous martial arts are here. Since he can't poison these rats now, he will never be able to poison them. I, the Sihaitang, will keep them, and see who dares to let our Sihaitang keep the chickens and dogs!"
The red-faced man said these words loud and clear, but Mr. Tang Da said: "Old Huang, what you said is too full!"
"I can't cure this poison... you go find someone else!" After that, he turned and left.
The red-faced man ordered his men: "Go and invite all the poison masters and the miracle doctor, and then ask Qi Qiuzi if the miracle doctor is here. Also, catch all these rats..." After that, he walked towards Qian Chen and said with a kind smile: "This little brother must be the one who just pointed out the poisoned rats!"
"I wonder what I call my little brother?"
The red-faced man patted Qian Chen's shoulder affectionately, and Qian Chen said shyly: "My name is Qian Chen, and I am a nobody."
"Haha... Brother Qian is a nobody now, and he will definitely become famous all over the world in the future. From today on, Brother Qian will no longer be a nobody. I wonder how Brother Qian could see this poison?"
Qian Chen didn't seem to see the hidden suspicion of the red-faced man, and said happily: "I have family medical skills, and I noticed something was wrong at first sight. This was the 'eliminating the roots' of the Biphosphorus Five Poison Sect in the past. He put poison on the lice. The more itchy the rats were bitten by the lice, the more they would rub against each other. In this way, the poison soon infected all the rats."
"These rats were driven by poison to escape from Sihaitang. The 'elimination' attack occurred and their rat hair fell off. At this time, the lice fell with the rat hair, and the clues of poisoning disappeared. At the same time, everyone only paid attention to the hairless rats and ignored the rat hair... This is his real killer."
"His real purpose is to eradicate the poison from the people present. When he needs it, he can make anyone go crazy and kill!"
After hearing what Qian Chen said, everyone at the entrance of Sihaitang went crazy. They took off their clothes desperately, scratched their bodies to look for lice, and pulled out their hair.
For a moment, the entrance of Sihaitang turned into a sea of ​​yellow, white, and black skin and flesh colors of various colors. The people of Linhai City stared at the entrance of the famous local Sihaitang in stunned silence. Everyone seemed to be on fire, ripping themselves into naked pigs.
The red-faced man also looked ugly. He endured the itchy phantom pain on his body and valued Qian Chen more and more.
Qian Chen was surprised and said, "Why do they need to take off their clothes?"
"Because I'm afraid of being poisoned!" The red-faced man cursed in his belly: "I'm also afraid of being poisoned! Damn it, who told me to save face? You can't move..."
Qian Chen seemed to come back to his senses and suddenly said: "Oh! I figured everything out when I found out that the poison was 'cutting the grass and rooting'. Then I put insecticide in the mouse hair, which has isolated the 'cutting the grass' infection process." After hearing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief, and someone yelled and cursed: "What a bastard, why didn't you tell me earlier?"
The red-faced man said loudly: "That's enough! How can you speak to your savior like this?" He cupped his fist at Qian Chen and said, "Thank you, little brother, for saving us all."
"I don't know when the little brother applied the insecticide. I didn't even notice."
"How can I bring an insecticide on my body?" Qian Chen said with a smile, "I just borrowed the poison from the person who poisoned it. He poisoned it and killed so many flies and bedbugs. This insecticide is the only one that can't kill lice, but I added a flavor to it, which is a medicinal fragrance. With this medicine, the lice are not immune to the insecticide poison, and they will naturally be poisoned to death."
Qian Chen took off the sachet from his waist, handed it to the red-faced man and said, "I use this medicinal fragrance to stimulate the toxicity of the insecticide, so IEverywhere they went, lice died. "
“I just walked into the rat swarm and already completed the detoxification process. "
The red-faced man smelled the sachet and found that it had a fragrant medicinal fragrance. He took the sachet with an extra thought and said to Qian Chen: "Little brother is really a distinguished guest of our Sihai Hall, please come in quickly..."
The red-faced man personally welcomed Qian Chen into the hall with all the courtesy. Qian Chen looked helpless and unable to resist the hospitality. His face was green and he looked extremely embarrassed. The red-faced man laughed and said: "Today, little brother is the honored guest of our Sihaitang. If anyone dares to neglect you, tell your brother that I will skin him... I wonder if little brother can still get rid of this poison of 'cutting the grass and root out' and save the face of our Sihaitang." "
"If I can save my face, brother, I will be rewarded! "
"I have read a few prescriptions in family medicine books. If the medicinal materials are complete, you can give them a try. Qian Chen said with a red face.
After introduction, Qian Chen learned that this red-faced man was named Huang Yuhan, and he was the master of Donghai Hall among the four halls of Sihai Hall, East, West, South and North. He is also the chief steward of Hong Sihai, responsible for the internal affairs of the main hall of Sihai Hall.
He has a high and powerful position in the world, but he rarely takes action, so it is impossible to estimate his level of martial arts.
Entering from the gate of Sihaitang, Qian Chen realized what a strict atmosphere meant. Countless sentries, both bright and hidden, prevented the Sihaitang's defense from pouring water. Especially because of the incident that had just happened, everyone was in high spirits, and their bodies became more and more murderous. Huang Yuhan took Qian Chen through the inner hall and along the corridor to a side hall.
"This side hall is used to store medicines in the hall. Although it is not an official internal storage warehouse, it has a complete range of medicinal materials. "
"Brother, can you take a look, are there any medicinal materials you are missing? "
Qian Chen pushed the door open and walked in, and was startled by the grandeur of Sihai Hall. The side hall was filled with paulownia wood shelves. A large number of precious medicinal materials were piled up on the shelves as if they were worthless. Qian Chen even smelled a faint musty smell due to poor preservation. Like a medical fanatic, he eagerly stepped forward to rummage through the boxes containing precious medicines.
“This is Kirin Blood Drainage produced overseas! "
“There are also borneols, lin’s toes, etc. Why did this jade tuckahoe get spoiled! "
“Little brother, you can choose whatever medicinal ingredients you want to prepare. " Huang Yuhan said with a smile. Qian Chen unceremoniously rolled up various precious medicinal materials, and asked for another hairless rat. He quickly prepared a decoction and drank the medicine. The rat kicked off its legs and died as expected. Huang Yuhan laughed loudly and did not mind, and offered more precious medicinal materials.
After Qian Chenzhi died three times, he finally prepared a decoction and fed it to the mouse. Although he was dying, he survived strongly.
(End of chapter)
